title: Which Failure Does an Intervention Repair? When Agent Interventions Help, and Where Self-Evolving Skills Stall
title_zh: 干预修复了哪类失败？智能体干预何时有效，自演化技能为何遇到瓶颈
abstract_en: An intervention that improves one agent can break another, and adding a stronger harness on top need not repair the damage. Agent interventions such as skills, harnesses, and extra inference budget are nonetheless usually credited with one average gain, measured under one setup. We ask instead when each intervention helps and which failure it repairs. A matched factorial study over nine benchmarks, four models, four skill conditions, four harness levels, and three budgets, with nearly 0.9 million trajectories, changes one axis at a time. No configuration is best everywhere, interventions interact rather than add, and a harness can absorb a skill's gain, rescue a failure the skill causes, or leave the gain intact. The failure left by the current system points to the fix: missing knowledge to a stronger model, execution errors to a richer harness. Yet feedback is not recovery: a matched recovery repairs mainly failures that leave a visible error signal. Skills that evolve from the agent's own experience hit a bottleneck: they rarely beat a short human-written skill, can learn dataset shortcuts, break when moved to another model, and cannot supply missing facts, which outside information does. A benchmark-level switch to the model favored by a 20-task labeled pilot achieves both higher performance and lower cost than always using the stronger model. Agent interventions should be judged by which failure they repair and under which configuration.
abstract_zh: 同一种干预可能提升一个智能体的表现，却让另一个退步；换用更强的运行框架（harness）也未必能挽回损失。与其用单一配置下的平均增益评价技能（skill）、运行框架和推理预算，本文追问：每种干预何时有效，又能修复哪类失败？研究通过配对析因实验，在 9 个基准、4 种模型、4 种技能条件、4 个运行框架等级和 3 档推理预算下，每次只改变一个因素，共分析近 90 万条运行轨迹。结果表明，没有一种配置在所有基准上都最优，干预效果也不能简单相加：运行框架可能抵消技能的额外收益、修复技能引发的失败，也可能保留其收益。当前系统的失败类型可以指明干预方向：知识缺失宜换用更强的模型，执行错误宜采用功能更完善的运行框架。但反馈不等于恢复：匹配的恢复机制主要能修复留下可见错误信号的失败。依靠智能体自身经验演化的技能很少胜过简短的人工编写技能，还可能学到数据集捷径，换模型后失效；它们也无法补足缺失的事实，而外部信息可以。每个基准先用 20 个带标注任务进行试测，再据此选用模型，比始终使用更强模型表现更好、成本更低。
key_points_zh: 近 90 万条轨迹的配对析因实验显示，没有通用最优配置；运行框架既可能抵消技能收益，也可能保留收益或修复技能引发的失败。
知识缺失优先考虑更强的模型，执行错误优先考虑更完善的运行框架；恢复机制主要对留下可见错误信号的失败有效。
自演化技能很少超过简短的人工技能，可能学到数据集捷径，也可能换模型后失效；补足缺失事实需要外部信息。
每个基准用 20 个标注任务试测后再选模型，比始终使用更强模型表现更好、成本更低。

agent-harness-evolution.reason: 核心贡献之一是直接评估从评分回合或成败轨迹中演化出的可复用技能。配对实验固定其他变量，并通过更换构建模型、跨模型迁移和引入外部检索检验技能的局限。结果支持在目标模型与运行框架中对照短人工技能，检查数据集捷径并权衡词元成本。所给摘录未详述技能更新流程，也未显示改进机制自身演化或模型参数更新。
agent-harness-evolution.quote:
Self-evolving skills promise to improve an agent from its own experience without changing the model or the
harness. The matched design shows four ways in which they fall short, and three experiments test why.
agent-harness-evolution.result_quote:
On Hotpot Context, GPT-5.6-sol
scores 62.0 at H1 without a skill and 13.6 with the SkillOpt skill optimized on Qwen3.5-9B, which makes
it fill its answer field with a fact-extraction worksheet; H2 and H3 both stay at 12.2, because the answer
stays well-formed and the outcome-blind revision does not correct it.
